video_title: OKC has some ‘tough decisions’ to make this offseason 👀 Is Chet in the future plans? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander reflects on the Thunder's playoff failure
quotes.excerpt: It was a failure. I failed at my goal. I didn't achieve what I wanted to achieve.
quotes.quote: It was a failure. I failed at my goal. I didn't achieve what I wanted to achieve. Through my experiences, I learned the most about myself and I make the greatest amount of increases I have in my career when I fail at my goal and don't get what I want. I look at this no different.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder face significant luxury tax implications for upcoming extensions
quotes.excerpt: They are going to be deep into luxury tax with the extensions for Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams.
quotes.quote: We have to start with what is the financial pain threshold for Clay Bennett and that ownership group. This is a team that has not paid luxury tax for the last six seasons. They are going to be deep into luxury tax with the extensions for Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams kicking in. They are going to vault into second apron territory. Isaiah Hartenstein has a team option, Luguentz Dort has a team option. It is extremely likely that Hartenstein is back. Obviously going up against Victor Wembanyama likely every year now, you don't want to thin out your front court depth.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander emphasizes the team's need for Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: We need Chet. Before Chet was here, we weren't who we are today.
quotes.quote: We need Chet. We just need Chet Holmgren. Before Chet was here, we weren't who we are today. We didn't have the success we had today. When he's the best version of himself, we're the best version of ourselves and it's no secret. The version of Chet that we have today is the worst version of Chet we'll ever have. He's going to get better at basketball.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on Chet Holmgren's struggles against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: It's not like Chet has an issue in the NBA, it's he has a Victor Wembanyama issue.
quotes.quote: It is obvious that this is a bad matchup. I know a lot of people were saying this is a rivalry right now, it looks like it's not because Victor Wembanyama versus Chet Holmgren, we know it's kind of more one-sided, especially when it comes to the NBA. It's not like Chet has an issue in the NBA, it's he has a Victor Wembanyama issue. He was open for shots, he just chose not to take them. Why? Because Wembanyama disrupted his whole flow.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green advises Chet Holmgren to focus on film study
quotes.excerpt: He has to be in the gym. He has to be in the film session.
quotes.quote: If I'm the Oklahoma City Thunder, I'm not panicking. There's a difference, Chet on the floor when you have a Jalen Williams, when you have AJ Mitchell, those guys open up the floor. But again, there is no excuse, so Chet has to do something for himself. I'm with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander here. He has to be in the gym. He has to be in the film session. Everybody has had a nemesis in their life. Everybody has had a rivalry in their life and they beat up on you. He has a bad mismatch. You make it a better matchup by getting better and in the gym. So you go back to those film sessions.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green analyzes the Knicks' tactical options against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks have many different ways they can skin a cat which is win the game.
quotes.quote: The Knicks have many different ways they can skin a cat which is win the game. And that's playing five out or playing big with the big big. And I expect them to play five out with Josh Hart, which then Wembanyama will have to guard Josh Hart. He can be in a drop, he can recover. This only works if Josh Hart is not aggressive shooting the basketball like he was in Game 2 of the Cleveland Cavaliers series where he had five threes. So if he's playing like this, Wembanyama can roam. He can be free safety. He can play at the basket, he can get out to the perimeter, but Josh Hart, he's got to knock these down.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike highlights OG Anunoby as the Knicks' best defender
quotes.excerpt: OG Anunoby is actually their best defender, no surprise here on Victor Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: OG Anunoby is actually their best defender, no surprise here on Victor Wembanyama. If you crunch the numbers, look, he limits him to the fewest amount of points relative to Karl-Anthony Towns who's trying, but everybody else, it's like popcorn season. That's barbecue chicken. 73 points per 100 matchups. You want to keep OG Anunoby on him. Why? I will show you because he has a good combination. He may not have the 7'5" height, but he has physicality, he's strong, and he can beat him to spots.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green argues regular season performance doesn't predict playoff outcomes
quotes.excerpt: The playoffs is so much different and teams that have been there experience matters.
quotes.quote: I mean, we've seen that last series to me, it showed it didn't matter at all. Because if it did, in that OKC-San Antonio series, the Spurs would have swept the Thunder, right? Or they won 4-1. But because the playoffs is so much different and teams that have been there experience matters, that OKC-San Antonio series was decided in a Game 7 without some guys missing and some stars. And down to like the last minute. They still had a chance to win. So this regular season, it was good, and in cup season tournament was a good one, but in the playoff series, this Spurs team is a different Spurs team. They've grown. Wembanyama's grown. He's seen the double big-big matchup before. Stefan Castle's grown. He's guarded Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, a two-time MVP. Now he has to guard Jalen Brunson.
